title: Domestication and lowland adaptation of coastal preceramic maize from Paredones, Peru
version: eLife 12:e83149, DOI 10.7554/eLife.83149. Publisher PDF rendered by search service.
lineage: Paleogenomics of Paredones cob material, including samples from an earlier excavation report. Independently informative for regional ancestry and timing, without sampling Xihuatoxtla maize.

passages.note: Directly dated husk/shank attached to Par_N1 was dated 6775–6504 cal BP (95.4%). The authors infer dispersal from Mesoamerica to South America but do not identify a particular Balsas donor community or prove their proposed route.
